verses.text: 60. He also said, ’Poverty, hardship, austerity and fasting, such are the instruments of the solitary life. It is written, ”When these three men are together, Noah, Job, and Daniel, there am I, says the Lord.” (cf. Ezek. 14.14) Noah represents poverty, Job suffering and Daniel discernment. So, if these three works are found in a man, the Lord dwells in him.’
